context:
Goal: the app has one name wherever you read it.
Problem (goal): only the home-screen label now says CH Post; the app's own messages, the Hand screen and the Chrome extension still use older names, and only you say whether they should match.
Based on (read): the leftover names on main: "Mail Day" in two web messages (src/app.jsx lines 2023 and 3878) and "Mail day" on the phone Hand screen (HandScreen.swift line 88); "MANIFEST orders" in the Chrome extension (manifest.json line 3, options.html line 7, core.mjs line 239).
Based on (read): the coordinator's note of 2026-11-21 19:11 CST: the in-app masthead stays MANIFEST either way, as the masthead-is-not-project-name record says.
Departs from: main shows Mail Day, Mail day and MANIFEST orders beside CH Post — this renames them all to CH Post (option b); option a leaves them.
Waiting on: your answer; nothing changes meanwhile.

options.gain: No churn; the extension and masthead keep their names.
options.how: Only the home-screen label says CH Post.
options.label: Leave them as they are
options.lose: The app keeps a mix of names: CH Post, Mail Day and MANIFEST.

options.gain: One name everywhere you read it.
options.how: The web messages, the Hand screen and the extension take the new name.
options.label: Rename them all to CH Post
options.lose: The Chrome extension's name changes from MANIFEST orders, so it no longer matches the MANIFEST masthead inside the app.

reply: You chose b, rename every leftover name to CH Post (2026-11-21 19:54 CST). Filed in git. The coordinator files the ruling and starts the lane. 19:57 CST.
short: Leftover names: leave or rename to CH Post

shown.label: Rename them all to CH Post

title: Should the leftover Mail Day and MANIFEST names follow CH Post?
why: Only the home-screen label changed; renaming the rest touches the extension and the masthead the record keeps, so leaving them is the smaller step (coordinator's recommendation).
